info.title: Standard GRC Platform - API Reference
info.description:
API-first agentic GRC platform for compliance assessments powered by the Secure Controls Framework (SCF). Features 7 specialized AI agents, assessment lifecycle management, document ingestion, knowledge base search, and multi-tenant authorization.

---


> **🤖 AI-Dev First**: Se você é um Agente Autônomo ou está configurando uma integração LLM, consuma nossa documentação contextual nativa em [`/llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt).
  

---



---

## 📖 Manuais & Cookbook

Consulte [`/llms-full.txt`](/llms-full.txt) para workflows completos e [`/llms.txt`](/llms.txt) para referência rápida.

BearerApiKey.description: API Key issued from the Standard dashboard. Prefix: `standard_live_` or `standard_test_`.

CookieSession.name: standard-native-auth.session_token
CookieSession.description: Session cookie set by Standard Native Auth after login.

post.description: PLATFORM ADMIN ONLY. Creates a new tenant (organization) in the system.

get.description: PLATFORM ADMIN ONLY. Retrieves the details of a specific tenant.

patch.description: PLATFORM ADMIN ONLY. Updates the status or details of a tenant.

post.description: Creates an organization under the authenticated tenant.

get.description: Returns all organizations for the specified tenant.

patch.description: Updates the name and/or slug of an organization.

delete.description: Soft-deletes an organization by marking it inactive. Data is retained for audit purposes.

get.description: Returns all API keys for the authenticated organization (masked). Use ?active=true to exclude revoked keys.

post.description: Creates a new M2M API key. The raw key is returned only once â€” store it securely.

patch.description: Update name, expiration date, and/or scopes of an existing API key.

post.description: Creates a new replacement key and schedules revocation of the old key after an optional grace period.

Retrieves the current lifecycle status and phase of an assessment.
Retrieves the chronological timeline of events for an assessment.
Evaluates if the assessment meets all requirements to pass its current gate.

put.description: Updates the automation execution rules for an assessment.

post.description: Clones an existing assessment into a new assessment cycle.

get.description: WebSocket connection for live collaboration on an assessment.
Retrieves the parsed text chunks for a processed document.
Lists all background processing jobs associated with a document.

post.description: Forces a document to be reprocessed by the ingestion pipeline.

get.description: Lists all document ingestion jobs for a given assessment.
Retrieves details of a specific ingestion job.

post.description: Forces a document to be embedded and added to the Knowledge Base.
Manually triggers the processing queue for a specific job.
Triggers AI agents to evaluate evidence against the Statement of Applicability.

get.description: Lists all evidence findings for a given assessment.
Retrieves a specific evidence finding by ID.

post.description: Forces a refresh of an evidence finding evaluation.

get.description: Retrieves the document sources that support a specific evidence finding.

post.description: Generates a new gap analysis draft based on the latest evidence evaluation.

get.description: Lists all gap analysis versions for a specific assessment.
Retrieves a specific gap analysis version by ID.
Lists all gap findings for a given gap analysis version.
Retrieves or updates a gap finding.

patch.description: Retrieves or updates a gap finding.

post.description: Runs validation checks against the gap analysis version to ensure completion.
Submits a drafted gap analysis version for review.
Approves a gap analysis version that was under review.
Creates a new version based on changes.
Applies a bulk update to multiple gap findings.
Evaluates raw evidence description against a control requirement.
Evaluates a batch of evidence in background.
Proposes architectural remediation based on evidence context.
Creates the initial scope definition for an assessment.

get.description: Retrieves the scope definition for a given assessment.
Retrieves a specific scope by its ID.

patch.description: Updates properties of an existing scope.

post.description: Submits a drafted scope for review.
Approves a scope that is under review.
Generates a new Statement of Applicability draft for an assessment.

get.description: Lists all Statement of Applicability versions for an assessment.
Retrieves a specific SoA version by its ID.
Lists all items (controls) in a specific SoA version.

patch.description: Updates an individual item in the Statement of Applicability.

post.description: Forces a refresh of evidence mapping for the SoA.
Submits a drafted SoA for review.
Approves an SoA that is under review.
Marks an approved SoA as fully ingested into the assessment.
Flags the SoA as needing re-ingestion.
Regenerates an SoA based on updated frameworks or scopes.

get.description: Runs validation checks against the SoA.

post.description: Dispatches long-running analysis across up to 500 contract snippets simultaneously. Returns a jobId for polling.
Transforms raw contract text into executive intelligence about sub-processors and LGPD/GDPR privacy compliance.

get.description: Returns a portable JSON export of all personal data stored for the authenticated user. Compliant with LGPD art. 18 (right of access and portability). The response includes a Content-Disposition header for download.

delete.description: Initiates an account deletion request. The account is flagged for deletion immediately. Personal data is permanently purged within 30 days per the data retention policy.

get.description: Returns SOC monitoring pipeline status: queue binding health, alert service configuration, and pipeline readiness. Requires admin:write permission (platform admin only).

Calculates the DPIA risk score based on data categories and implemented controls.
Calculates compliance score against a specific regulation based on implemented controls.
Checks data retention rules based on category, purpose, and jurisdiction.
Determines breach notification SLA based on regulation and severity.
Calculates coverage mapping between a source framework and a target framework.
